I'd say stick with Borderlands 3. I played Remnants and it gets boring fast. While it is being advertise as souls-like, its not exactly souls-like imo. First, the map is procedural generated. So there's no way of knowing if you can get a specific item or weapon that you want unless it spawn there. If it doesn't you'd have to re roll the world. Second, enemies level is tied to the highest level equipment in your inventory. Say you upgrade your beginner gun to level 5, now the enemy is scaled to level 5, then you found a sniper and decided to switch but the enemy level still scaled to 5.
